Bytes stayed 18602? The replacement added a newline but maybe the same length? Original line was long; splitting adds a newline and removes nothing? Actually "not a proposition: the paper-side q-pilot times-mu strip together\nwith" vs "not a proposition:\nthe paper-side ... together with" — same character count except newline vs space. Fine.

Now final hashes again (the olean changed due to doc? Doc changes may not change olean content much but hash will). Compute.

content.arguments:
{"code": "
const r = await tools.pwsh({ description: "Final hashes after wrap", command: `
$f = "D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1960QPilotAnchorActual.lean"
$o = "D:\\lean\\.lake\\build\\lib\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1960QPilotAnchorActual.olean"
"LEAN_SHA256=" + (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $f).Hash
"LEAN_BYTES=" + (Get-Item $f).Length
"LEAN_TOTAL_LINES=" + ((Get-Content $f).Count)
"OLEAN_SHA256=" + (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 $o).Hash
"OLEAN_BYTES=" + (Get-Item $o).Length
"OLEAN_PATH=" + $o
"OLEAN_LASTWRITE=" + (Get-Item $o).LastWriteTime.ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssK")
"LOG_TAIL:"; Get-Content "D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1960.olean.log" -Tail 3
`, workdir: "D:\\lean" });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? r.stdout.text : JSON.stringify(r));
", "description": "Final hash report"}
